biography.notes: Took the shot meant for you outside the Glasswick relay and lost two fingers to the frost after; she never brings it up, but you always check her gloves.

description.value:
"Somebody has to stand where the trouble is."

Bravo is the Violence Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: guard, soldier, bandit, bouncer, duelist, caravan outrider. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Shieldwall: Allies within reach add +1 Guard (+2 at Tier III). The Bravo is why the militia line holds.

Aptitude kit: signature aptitude Melee rank = tier; secondary Brawl rank = tier − 1.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Violence marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Aurablade or Bulwark. A Steward is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Bravo — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Stand a watch: Guard a person, door, or camp for a night/shift. Standard fee 10 marks (Violence).

Trick — Hold the Line (1/scene): When an adjacent ally is hit, the Bravo takes the hit instead.

Echoes are the past made flesh — people out of a Steward's former lives, walking beside them again. Beryl Achen is an echo of Toblerone's time with the Covert Ops Cell crew. Being remembered leaves a mark.

Sniper — Took the shot meant for you outside the Glasswick relay and lost two fingers to the frost after; she never brings it up, but you always check her gloves.

Never Here — Apprentice (Echo Boon)

Once per scene, retroactively establish the echo was somewhere else; one witness's account of them unravels.

Echo's Mark: while their Steward can see them, the echo adds +1 on any check made in direct support of the Steward.

Officially, this person does not exist. Officially never changed.

Human. Normalized Bad Eden ancestry root.

Select one heritage separately when building the character: Cro-Magnon, Denisovan, Florensis, Neanderthal.

This root grants the shared Human core trait package and preserves live UUID compatibility for existing feature items.

“Humanity is not special. It’s just stubborn enough to keep moving when reality begs it to stop.”

Adaptive. 1/Soma Break, when you fail a check, you can choose to succeed instead.

Tenacious. While you have 1 Integrity, you reroll the lowest die on one check of your choice each round (declare before rolling).

Lineage Memory. Choose one human lineage (Cro-Magnon, Denisovan, Florensis, Neanderthal). Your lineage grants Tier powers as you level.

Human Lineage. The branch that kept the strength. Heavy bone, deep lung, the ancestor who decided that an ice age is a problem you out-mass.

“The map says ‘stop.’ You keep walking. Slower. Heavier. The map gives up first.”

Neanderthal. You are the broad lineage that survived by being the thing the cold couldn’t finish.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.

  • Size. Medium.

  • Lineage Lean. Your lineage leans toward VIO (Violence)—expressed primarily through Tier powers.

  • Endurance Frame. You count as one size larger for the purposes of carrying capacity, push, drag, and lift.

advancement.hint: Gain your Neanderthal Tier I lineage power (Thick-Boned).

description.value:
“You are built for cold, conflict, and clan.”

Thick-Boned. You have resistance to thermal damage, and you reroll the lowest die on checks or checks against being knocked prone.

Clan Memory. You gain a skill rank in Insight or Athletics.

description.value:
A long mail hauberk over a padded coat, with riveted plate at the chest and shoulders. The standard heavy issue for Bulwarks who haven't earned signature plate yet. Weight you have to carry. Weight that carries back.

Standard Issue. Path-defining silhouette without path-defining cost. Frame Dice and Ruin Charges still come from your Bulwark features — the hauberk is just the surface they sit on.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Heavy
  • Defense: Guard +2, Resolve +1
  • Requires: Plating (trained)
  • Tier: I
  • Cost: 75 Nonlethal marks

item.signature: Heavy enough to remind you you're standing somewhere on purpose.

description.value:
A small round buckler stamped from sheet steel and laced to a leather forearm cuff. Faction-pressed in batches of a thousand and handed out to whoever could close their fingers around the grip. Half ward, half noisemaker — the dent in the front is where someone else's mistake stopped.

Standard Issue. Pairs with any one-handed weapon. No signature, no attunement, no apologies for the dent.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Shield
  • Defense: Guard +1
  • Requires: Warding (trained)
  • Tier: I
  • Cost: 50 Economy marks
